title: yupana: frontier recompute and the serving surface never meet in one process
description: Filed in bobbin's tracker because yupana/.beads redirects to a town-level DB absent in this environment. FR-16's update_frontier_bounded (yupana src/graph/overlay.rs:126-141) has exactly one production caller: OverlayRefresh::heavy, constructed only by 'yupana watch --tenant' over a TenantRegistry built inline (cli_serve.rs:22-33) that no server holds — the recomputed overlay is unqueryable. The daemon's POST /edit (src/daemon/tenanted.rs:110-152) does touch + 1-hop caller advisory instead. Both halves real, wire missing: hold the watch-path registry in the resident daemon (FR-31) so edits drive frontier recompute on a queryable graph.

title: yupana: pre-edit hook does not invoke verify — hallucination rejection absent from blocking seam
description: verify_buffer (yupana src/verify/mod.rs) rejects unknown identifiers/arity/unresolved imports but has no caller in src/hook/; the PreToolUse guard checks capability/blast-radius/text rules only. A hallucinated reference is rejected only when something explicitly calls verify. Provisional D section 9.2(3) (camayoc docs/patents/provisional-grounding-cluster.md) discloses the combined pre-landing gate as contemplated — implement verify as an opt-in arm of pre-edit within its latency budget.

title: yupana: code-fact freshness tracked but unserved; CLAUDE.md claim incomplete
description: yupana watch/overlay_refresh.rs maintains real Recomputing-to-Fresh transitions but freshness_handle/freshness_of have zero production callers outside the module; no query surface serves code-fact freshness (correctly omitted, per FR-3). CLAUDE.md's 'freshness half is Phase 3, not yet served' is incomplete: the verdict surface serves PROJECTION freshness (src/hook/rule_planes.rs:546-566, src/verdict.rs:129). Distinguish code-fact vs projection freshness in docs; wire tracked freshness into query responses at Phase 3.

title: Quipu Integration
description:
Integrate Quipu as Bobbin's knowledge graph subsystem.

See docs/plans/quipu-integration.md for full roadmap.

Phases:
1. Crate dependency (feature-gated behind 'knowledge')
2. Shared ONNX embedding pipeline  
3. MCP tool surface (knowledge_query, knowledge_context)
4. Unified search results (code + knowledge)
5. Knowledge-aware context assembly

Current state: quipu crate linkage exists (commit 14ea03e) with
knowledge_context + knowledge_query MCP tools as path dep.

Repo: github.com/scbrown/bobbin

title: file-size ratchet red on main: 10 files over the 500-line limit
description: just check fails on main before any change is made: scripts/check-file-size.sh reports 10 errors (src/cli/bead.rs 1179 lines, src/http/handlers/archive.rs 846, src/cli/ontology.rs 663, src/index/cross_repo.rs 620, six more) and 7 warnings. A permanently-red gate trains contributors to ignore it — the control-that-cannot-fail failure mode. Pitch: split the ten files or move them deliberately to scripts/large-file-allowlist.txt with rationale, restoring the gate's meaning.

title: yupana: PromoteResponse is the only served response without a tier
description: Every served DTO carries tier (FR-3) except PromoteResponse (yupana src/mcp/tools.rs:451-470). Defensible (write outcome, not derived fact) but the tier-on-every-envelope invariant is cleaner without exceptions. Add the promoted facts' tier or document the exemption in the spec's FR-3 section.
